question: Change in savings ÷ Change in Income = ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Marginal propensity to save**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The change in savings divided by the change in income is the marginal propensity to save (MPS)
 
• MPS = δ S / δ Y
 
• δ S is the change in savings, δ Y is the change in income&
